verdicts.description: One verdict per claim, in the same order as the claims.

claim.description: The claim being checked, copied as given.

verdict.description: supported: the evidence states it, it follows directly from it, or it is common knowledge that is certainly true. contradicted: the evidence or certain common knowledge says otherwise. unsupported: neither.

evidence.description: The label and the exact words of the evidence block that supports or contradicts the claim, like '[tool multiply] 7006652'; 'common knowledge'; or an empty string when the claim is unsupported.

confidence.description: How sure you are that your verdict is right, from 0 to 1. For unsupported: how sure you are that the evidence does not say it and it is not common knowledge.
